items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse license from the state of California (RN:CA) – Required upon hire
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) American Heart Association
Current Unrestriced Driver’s License from the state of California
Bachelor Of Nursing Graduate of accredited Registered Nurse (RN) program, Health Education program, or related field.
Four (4) years of nursing experience, with at least two (2) years in an acute care setting OR A minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a clinical setting.
Foster a cooperative effort in meeting the goals of the team and sharing the workload.
Monitor education program(s) effectiveness and provide recommendations for improvement based on feedback and outcomes.
Complete grant work plan activities based on the grant requirements as assigned.
Utilize policies and procedures when performing assigned activities.
Chart according to grant and community health guidelines.
Develop and maintain relationships with program participants, ensuring all instructors and participants are supported with necessary information and materials.
